I added an explicit .strip() in __post_init__ before .title(), which gives the expected 'Oslo'. I left the config alone. Passing a ConfigDict dict via config= is the supported v2 form; the deprecation finding is about class-based Config, which this file no longer uses. I did not change the @dataclass(config=StrictConfig) line. I could not run the test here, so the fix is unverified. If the strip still fails after this edit, the cause is elsewhere (for example, the installed pydantic version or how the test imports the module)."}
